COURSE_OBJECTIVE: Help staff and supervisors set SMART objectives, track performance throughout the year and conduct fair, evidence-based appraisals.
COURSE_DESCRIPTION: Covers the full performance cycle: goal setting, continuous feedback, documentation, the appraisal interview and development planning, aligned with annual performance evaluation practice in the public service.
